controles.affirmation: Les defauts techniques touchant l'ensemble de la flotte eolienne restent un risque significatif ; les provisions de garantie pourraient ne pas refleter les taux de defaillance actualises
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025, Risk Themes : «In the SG Business Area, technical defects or quality issues affecting the entire fleet remain a significant risk. [...] Moreover, existing warranty or service contract provisions may not reflect updated failure rates, increasing the risk of insufficient accruals.»

controles.affirmation: La mise a jour annuelle des modeles statistiques de la flotte a genere un effet negatif en FY2025, plus faible qu'en FY2024
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : «The update of warranty costs and provisions, including the regular annual update of the statistical models used to evaluate the entire wind turbine fleet, resulted in negative effects, although these were lower than in fiscal year 2024.»

controles.affirmation: Tarifs douaniers americains sur l'acier et l'aluminium et mesures de retorsion qualifies de risques economiques importants ; resultat FY2025 impacte par les droits de douane
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : «The country- and material-specific tariffs introduced by the U.S. government under President Trump - particularly on steel and aluminum - as well as the retaliatory tariffs imposed in response, pose significant economic risks and carry the potential for further trade escalation.» ; «Profit development was impacted by U.S. import tariffs.»

controles.affirmation: Chaine d'approvisionnement classee 2e risque, cyber 4e, execution de projets 6e sur les dix Risk Themes
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : «we present the significant Risk Themes, i.e., the top ten risks as prioritized by the Executive Board, in descending order of their relevance». Ordre effectif : 1 Political instability and conflicts, 2 Critical supply chain, 3 Adverse developments in financial and bank markets, 4 Business interruption or data leakage due to cyber attack, 5 Technical and quality Issues, 6 Risk from project execution.

controles.affirmation: Commandes Siemens Gamesa a 1 050 M€ contre 4 890 M€ (-78,5 %), book-to-bill 0,38, carnet du segment a 31 Mds € contre 162 Mds € pour le groupe (book-to-bill 1,57)
controles.verbatim_source: Earnings Release Q3 FY2026 : «Siemens Gamesa 1,050 4,890 (78.5)% (77.0)%» ; «Orders declined sharply compared with prior-year quarter's level. The prior year included two large orders in the offshore business worth more than EUR 3bn [...] Book-to-bill ratio was 0.38 and the order backlog decreased to EUR 31bn.» ; «Book-to-bill ratio [...] was 1.57, while order backlog increased to EUR 162bn»

controles.affirmation: Book-to-bill des trois autres segments : Gas Services 2,65, Grid Technologies 1,48, Transformation of Industry 1,19
controles.verbatim_source: Earnings Release Q3 FY2026 : «Book-to-bill ratio was 2.65 and order backlog increased to EUR 73bn» ; «Book-to-bill ratio was 1.48 and the order backlog increased to EUR 51bn» ; «Book-to-bill ratio was 1.19, order backlog at the end of the quarter was EUR 8bn»

controles.affirmation: Resultat net trimestriel de -2 931 M€ au T3 FY2023 contre +1 188 M€ au T3 FY2026 ; perte annuelle de 4 588 M€ sur l'exercice 2023
controles.verbatim_source: Earnings Release Q3 FY2023 : «Siemens Energy reported a Net loss of EUR 2,931m» ; Earnings Release Q3 FY2026 : «Net income also increased sharply to EUR 1,188m» ; Earnings Release Q4 FY2023 : «Net loss of Siemens Energy was EUR 4,588m»

controles.affirmation: « Huit trimestres consecutifs beneficiaires » (repris aussi dans ce_qui_affaiblirait)
controles.verbatim_source: Earnings Release Q4 FY2024 : «Siemens Energy incurred a Net loss of EUR 254m (Q4 FY 2023: Net loss EUR 870m) in the quarter». La serie beneficiaire ne commence donc qu'au T1 FY2025 : 252, 501, 697, 236, 746, 835, 1 188 M€, soit sept trimestres consecutifs jusqu'au T3 FY2026 (somme FY2025 = 1 686 M€ et cumul Q1-Q3 FY2026 = 2 769 M€, tous deux recoupes avec les communiques).
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer « huit trimestres consecutifs beneficiaires » par « sept trimestres consecutifs beneficiaires depuis le premier trimestre de l'exercice 2025, apres une perte de 254 M€ au quatrieme trimestre de l'exercice 2024 ».

controles.affirmation: Siemens Gamesa « a coute au groupe plus de 4,5 Mds € de pertes sur le seul exercice 2023 a cause de defauts de flotte »
controles.verbatim_source: Earnings Release Q4 FY2023, tableau segments FY2023, ligne Siemens Gamesa : «(4,347) (617) (92) (96) (4,439) (713)», soit une perte avant elements speciaux de 4 347 M€ et un resultat de -4 439 M€. Sur les causes : «there were negative effects at Siemens Gamesa due to quality issues in particular of the 4.X and 5.X onshore turbines as well as increased product costs and ramp-up challenges in the offshore business» ; la charge du T3 FY2023 est de «EUR 2.2bn which included EUR 1.6bn related to quality issues of certain onshore platforms».
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : « Siemens Gamesa a enregistre une perte de 4 347 M€ avant elements speciaux sur l'exercice 2023, dont 1,6 Md € de charges directement liees aux defauts de qualite des plateformes terrestres 4.X et 5.X, le reste venant de surcouts produits et de la montee en cadence offshore ».

controles.affirmation: Siemens Gamesa a degage 75 M€ avant elements speciaux au T3 FY2026, premier resultat positif depuis 2022, et vise l'equilibre sur FY2026 avec une croissance guidee de 3 % a 5 %
controles.verbatim_source: Earnings Release Q3 FY2026 : «Siemens Gamesa 1,050 4,890 [...] 75 (438) 2.7% (17.5)%» ; «Siemens Gamesa reported a positive result for the first time since fiscal year 2022 and is on track to reach break-even for 2026» ; «Siemens Gamesa assumes a comparable revenue growth of 3% to 5% and a Profit margin before Special items at break-even.»

controles.affirmation: Notations BBB- chez S&P et Baa2 chez Moody's, perspective positive pour les deux
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : «Standard & Poor's revised its outlook to 'positive' in May 2025» avec «The investment grade rating of BBB- remained unchanged» ; «In June 2025, Moody's issued a rating for Siemens Energy for the first time. With a long-term rating of Baa2 and a positive outlook»
